contentText:
Steven Rosenbush / Wall Street Journal :

Paris-based Genesis AI, which is building a general-purpose robot with greater dexterity for warehouses and homes, raised a $500M Series A at a $3.5B valuation   —  'We're working to build the world's best general-purpose robot,' says CEO Zhou Xian  —  Genesis AI said today it has raised $500 million …
